response.courseDescription: 413 Mechanical Behavior of Materials Elasticity, elastic stress distributions; plastic deformation of single and polycrystals; introduction to dislocation theory and its applications; creep, fracture, fatigue. (Crosslisted course offered as MSE 413, ME 413.)
response.coursePrerequisites: CE 215 and MSE 201, both with a C or better; OR MSE 202 with a C or better.
